<thought>Based on the observed ESI‑MS peak at m/z ≈ 199.0, the most plausible molecular ion is [M+H]⁺, giving a neutral exact mass of ~198.0 Da. The formula C₉H₁₀O₅ matches this mass (calculated monoisotopic mass = 198.0528 Da) and is the simplest composition that fits the data, so we report it as the molecular formula.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H10O5</final_answer>
